description: Run a shell command. The session workspace is the working directory, so relative paths resolve there and no cd is needed unless you mean to work elsewhere. Returns combined stdout+stderr.

approval_prefix.description: Optional: when this command will need approval and is part of a routine you expect to repeat, propose the command prefix the human may remember for the rest of the session, e.g. ["git", "pull"]. It must be the command's own leading words, at least two; interpreter, deleter, and escalator heads are never remembered.

run_in_background.description: Run asynchronously and return a task id immediately.

name: bash

description: Write content to a file (creates parent dirs).
name: write_file

description: Replace the first exact occurrence of old_text with new_text.
name: edit_file

description: Find workspace files matching a glob pattern.
name: glob

description: Create/replace the task checklist. Use for multi-step work.
name: TodoWrite

description: Delegate isolated work to a subagent with a fresh context. 'Explore' is read-only; 'general-purpose' may also edit files. Returns only the subagent's final summary.
name: task

description: Load a named skill's full instructions. Use scope=agent for deployment-provided skills or scope=user for the current owner's skills.
name: load_skill

description: Manually compress the conversation to free context.
name: compress

description: Ask the human operator one clarifying question and wait for their reply. Use sparingly -- prefer acting on the information you have. The reply may take a while; if nobody answers, you will be told so.
name: ask_user
